title: Charts as Epistemic Actions for Experience-Driven Agentic Data Analysis
title_zh: 图表作为经验驱动智能体数据分析中的认知行动

paragraphs.en: 研究图表作为数据智能体的认知行动，通过经验蒸馏让智能体学会在推理中使用图表。 Data agents built on ReAct-style loops now execute complex analytical workflows over structured data, yet their intermediate reasoning still runs almost entirely through text. Human analysts instead move between numbers, tables, and charts, reading visual evidence to expose trends and anomalies that text summaries drop. We ask whether charts can serve as internal epistemic actions inside a data agent's reasoning loop, and how to teach an agent to use them. We first build \probe{}, a suite of 200 controlled tasks under four matched interface conditions, and find a persistent gap between what agents can read and what they choose to use. Agents score as well from self-generated charts as from numeric output, yet plotting access alone does not translate into consistent use. Task slices show that charts lead on temporal, pattern, and anomaly reasoning, while text leads on precise reading and conditional verification. We then propose \method{}, which distils two families of experience from conditioned trajectory rollouts. One family records how to select and verify analytical operations, and the other records when to invoke text, charts, or both. A trajectory judge scores outcomes and labels intermediate steps, and a validation gate admits only experience that improves held-out performance. On three held-out benchmarks with four LLM backbones, \method{} raises analytical accuracy and visual evidence quality over matched baselines, and backbones that never drew charts begin using them, all without touching model parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 研究图表作为数据智能体的认知行动，通过经验蒸馏让智能体学会在推理中使用图表。基于 ReAct 风格循环构建的数据智能体已能在结构化数据上执行复杂的分析工作流，但其中间推理几乎仍然完全通过文本进行。 人类分析师则会在数字、表格和图表之间来回切换，通过读取可视化证据来揭示文本摘要所丢失的趋势和异常。 我们探究图表能否作为数据智能体推理循环内部的认知行动，以及如何教会智能体使用它们。 我们首先构建 \probe{}，这是一套在四种匹配的接口条件下设计的包含 200 个受控任务的测试集，并发现智能体能够读取的内容与它们选择使用的内容之间存在持续差距。 智能体从自生成图表中获得的得分与从数值输出中获得的得分相当，然而仅有绘图权限并不足以转化为一致的使用。 任务切片显示，图表在时间、模式和异常推理上占优，而文本在精确读取和条件验证上占优。 随后我们提出 \method{}，它从条件化轨迹 rollout 中蒸馏出两类经验。 一类记录如何选择和验证分析操作，另一类记录何时调用文本、图表或两者兼用。 轨迹评判器对结果进行评分并标注中间步骤，验证门控只允许采纳能提升留出集性能的经验。 在使用四个 LLM 骨干模型的三个留出基准上，\method{} 相较匹配的基线提升了分析准确率和视觉证据质量，并且原本从不绘制图表的骨干模型也开始使用图表，而这一切都无需改动模型参数。
